characters.summary: Ganondorf is a powerful wielder of dark magic and the Triforce of Power, fighting with colossal physical strength, heavy swordsmanship, and devastating curse spells.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to holy weapons such as the Master Sword and Silver Arrows.
limitations: Overconfident in his power and susceptible to having his energy attacks deflected back at him.

sources.supports: Background, magical abilities, and status as the primary antagonist of The Legend of Zelda.

feats.claim: Conquered the Kingdom of Hyrule using dark magic and the Triforce of Power.

notableResults.note: Defeated by Link wielding the Master Sword and aided by the Sages.

Casts spells and dark energy balls in combat.

unknowns: Extent of his power fluctuations across different timeline branches.

characters.summary: Garrus Vakarian is a veteran turonian sniper and tactical combat expert who excels at long-range precision firefights and tech sabotage.
weaknesses: Vulnerable in close-quarters melee combat against heavily armored brutes.
limitations: Relies heavily on ammunition and line-of-sight for ranged attacks.

sources.supports: Background, sniper training, and combat role in the Mass Effect series.

feats.claim: Survived as the vigilante Archangel on Omega holding off multiple mercenary syndicates.

notableResults.note: Fought off wave after wave of mercenaries on Omega.

campaignTags.claim: Uses tech abilities like Overload and mines in combat.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability without shields.

characters.summary: Geralt of Rivia is a mutant monster hunter who combines superhuman swordsmanship with quick magical signs, alchemy, and tactical preparation.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to overwhelming magical onslaughts and poison without proper potions.
limitations: Signs require stamina; potions have toxic side effects if overused.

sources.supports: General attributes, combat style, and witcher abilities of Geralt.

feats.claim: Slain numerous powerful monsters including dragons, vampires, and griffins.

notableResults.note: Defeated the Wild Hunt commander in single combat.

campaignTags.claim: Casts witcher signs like Igni and Quen.

unknowns: Full capacity against beings outside his universe's lore.

characters.summary: Guile is an elite military combatant who relies on solid defensive fundamentals, crushing martial arts, and projectile sonic booms.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to unpredictable mix-ups and cross-ups if caught out of position.
limitations: Relies on charge-motion mechanics requiring brief setup time for special moves.

sources.supports: Moveset, military background, and fighting style of Guile.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with top world martial artists and thwarted Shadaloo operations.

notableResults.note: Successfully confronted and defeated M. Bison in combat.

unknowns: Limits of his sonic wave durability against heavy artillery.

characters.summary: Illidan Stormrage is a night elf demon hunter who fights with twin warglaives, fel magic, and ferocious melee agility.

mechanisms: High evasion and parrying with warglaives

weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy divine magic and binding spells.
limitations: Consuming excessive fel energy risks complete corruption and madness.

sources.supports: History, demon hunter powers, and abilities of Illidan Stormrage.

feats.claim: Assassinated a pit lord and absorbed its power.

notableResults.note: Defeated in a duel at the Frozen Throne by Arthas.

campaignTags.claim: Wields powerful fel and arcane magic.
Casts fel spells and energy beams.

unknowns: Exact limits of his immortality after absorbing the soul of a prime Naaru.

characters.summary: Metamorphosis Illidan is a towering demon form that drastically enhances his melee striking power and unleashes searing aura damage.

mechanisms: Massively increased health pool and thick demonic hide

weaknesses: Temporary duration before reverting back to standard night elf form.
limitations: Lasts only a limited time per usage.
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Illidan into a massive winged demon, trading finesse for tremendous physical durability, flight, and continuous fire/fel aura damage.

notableResults.note: Used demon form capabilities to conquer major demonic resistance.

unknowns: Exact duration limit of the transformation.
